milestones.title: 1.0 · Trusted local publication
milestones.goal: Reproducibly publish domain-owned accepted aggregates offline.
milestones.exit: Three contracted products with quality, lineage, last-good state and acceptance evidence.

milestones.title: 2.0 · Snowflake-native migration
milestones.goal: Replace Dagster with SQL-native Snowflake RAW/SILVER/GOLD, governed publication and Tasks.
milestones.exit: Native SQL and local CI completed; a measured account-side parity, access, cost and recovery review is separately required.

milestones.title: 2.1 · Federated onboarding
milestones.goal: Qualify independently owned second-region products with common platform controls.
milestones.exit: Owner, consumer, semantics, recovery and governance gates accepted.

items.title: Publish first-party domain aggregates
items.story: As Business Improvement, I need trusted carrier trends to choose routes for review.
items.acceptance: Run the seed and reconcile shipment count with Silver. An Operations owner and two consumer teams appear in the catalogue.

items.title: Protect last-good Serving snapshot
items.story: As an analyst, I need dashboards to remain usable when one refresh contains invalid amounts.
items.acceptance: Inject a negative amount. Silver blocks Gold, CSV retains the same publication ID, a later healthy run resolves the alert.

items.title: Version contracts with independent review
items.story: As Finance Planning, I need a producer to change a schema without breaking existing consumers.
items.acceptance: Removal is blocked. A nullable append needs steward approval and appears in Serving only after a healthy refresh.

items.title: Prove Dispatch reuse and lineage
items.story: As a Finance analyst, I need to reconcile spend using the same source revision rules as Operations.
items.acceptance: Healthy replays of the shared dispatch feed yield the same Bronze digest and Silver counts. Finance includes pending dispatches, Operations counts delivered shipments.

items.title: Migrate processing and orchestration to Snowflake
items.story: As a Data Enablement Product Owner, I need native Snowflake ingestion, processing, quality and publication without a separate Dagster scheduler.
items.acceptance: RAW staging plus SILVER/GOLD views, guarded publication procedure, secure readers and suspended Tasks are versioned; cloud parity, access denials and credits await a sandbox.

items.title: Prove Snowflake restore, privileges and cost
items.story: As Platform SRE and Finance, we need real sandbox execution, restore and credit evidence before enabling scheduled refreshes.
items.acceptance: Run role-denial probes, rejected/healthy replay, credit measurements and restore against an approved test account.

items.title: Sponsor a second-region onboarding
items.story: As a new domain owner, I need a launch checklist with sign-off, SLA and consumer responsibilities.
items.acceptance: A domain team ships its own contract and quality checks, names two consumers and runs the recovery walkthrough.

items.title: Validate Marketing adoption and metric fitness
items.story: As Marketing, I need return reasons that inform a campaign review without suggesting a sales-normalised return rate.
items.acceptance: Marketing and Product Management both use a governed export and confirm that denominator and classification are adequately explained.
items.evidence: Returns Pulse metric definition and docs/product.md.
